item.title: How the Epstein Files Are Forcing a Reckoning with Power
item.description: The New Yorker staff writer Joshua Rothman joins Tyler Foggatt to discuss the political and cultural fallout from the release of millions of documents from the criminal investigation into Jeffrey Epstein. item.title: Man of Styles Justin Hicks Breaks Down the Making of His Debut LP, In-Studio
item.description: Singer-songwriter Justin Hicks spent years recording and touring with acclaimed bassist Meshell Ndegeocello, experiencing her genre-agnostic approach to music first-hand. In his debut album, Man Of Style, he is just as hard to pin down stylistically as his long-time collaborator. Yet he manages to fuse a rich array of R&B, soul, rock, jazz, and folk music, dressing his songs in each genre effortlessly. item.description: Justin Hicks – "Man Of Style" (Soundcheck Podcast) The singer and songwriter Justin Hicks is musically omnivorous. item.title: Mavis Staples at the Beacon Theatre
item.description: Mavis Staples at the Beacon TheatreFeb. 28. 8PM. $63.65 Mavis Staples has been one of the great voices in American popular music since the 60s.
